Package com.example.cab302assignment.model

Class UserRiskScore

java.lang.Object
com.example.cab302assignment.model.UserRiskScore
public class UserRiskScore extends Object
Model representing a user's aggregate risk score.

A UserRiskScore summarises a user's accumulated risk across all of their analysed prompts. It holds the latest numerical score, the derived categorical RiskLevel, the number of prompts that contributed to the score, and the timestamp of the most recent update.

Instances are typically loaded from the database, refreshed by recalculate(List) when new RiskAnalysis records become available, and persisted via a UserRiskScoreDAO.

  • Constructor Details

    • UserRiskScore

      public UserRiskScore()
      Creates an empty UserRiskScore.

      Provided primarily for frameworks (JavaBeans, DAOs) that construct the instance and then populate it through setters.

    • UserRiskScore

      public UserRiskScore(int userId, double score, int totalPromptsAnalysed, LocalDateTime lastUpdated)
      Creates a fully populated UserRiskScore.

      The score is applied via setScore(double) so the derived RiskLevel is set consistently. The scoreId is not set by this constructor and is expected to be assigned by the persistence layer.

      Parameters:
      userId - identifier of the user this score belongs to
      score - the aggregate numerical risk score
      totalPromptsAnalysed - the number of prompts that contributed to the score
      lastUpdated - the timestamp at which the score was last recalculated

    • setScore

      public void setScore(double score)
      Sets the numerical risk score and updates the derived RiskLevel to match.

      The risk level is chosen by comparing score against the thresholds defined on the RiskLevel enum, in descending order from RiskLevel.CRITICAL down to RiskLevel.NO.

      Parameters:
      score - the new aggregate risk score

    • recalculate

      public void recalculate(List<RiskAnalysis> history)
      Recalculates this user's aggregate risk score from their analysis history.

      The new score is the mean of the RiskLevel.scoreDouble() values for every entry in history; analyses with a null risk level contribute 0.0. The totalPromptsAnalysed and lastUpdated fields are updated to reflect the new calculation.

      If history is null or empty, the score is reset to 0.0 with zero prompts analysed.

      Parameters:
      history - the user's prior risk analyses; may be null or empty to indicate no history
